title: Avoozl machine host configuration
description: Machine-local, non-secret registration for the workspaces served by one Avoozl host.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Ignored and dropped on the next save. lanes.local in the machine Avoozl configuration sets how many chats this machine runs.

serve.description: Run the standalone page under this machine's supervisor. Machine file only: a repository's .avoozl.json may not set it.

enabled.description: Start avoozl serve as a supervised child, and restart it when it exits. It prints no owner link: run avoozl serve link at this machine's shell.

port.description: A fixed port, so the address stays the same across restarts. Omit for a random free port.

engine.description: The build this machine's tick runs. Machine file only: a repository's .avoozl.json may not set it.

update.description: Build Avoozl's newest main once its required checks pass on that commit, and run the tick from that build. The page, app backend and MCP server still change only with the app's Update.

telemetry.description: Export task timing to an OTLP endpoint. Machine file only: a repository's .avoozl.json may not set it. The OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* environment of the process that runs the tick beats endpoint, protocol and headers, and header values come only from OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS.

enabled.description: Send traces and metrics. Off by default.

endpoint.description: The collector's base URL: https, or http to localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1. No user, password or query. /v1/traces and /v1/metrics are added.

protocol.description: OTLP over HTTP with JSON bodies, the only protocol sent.

headers.description: Header names each request needs. Their values come from OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS and are never stored.

links.description: Where this machine's page opens worker chats (direct-links). Machine file only: a repository's .avoozl.json may not set it.

dashboard.description: The Kiro Crew web dashboard address the standalone page opens chats in: https, or http to this machine. An address only, no sign-in in it.

desktop.description: On the standalone page, offer Open in Kiro Crew, which opens a local chat in the Kiro Crew desktop app (kirocrew://).

epicContext.description: Extra reads and MCP servers a worker session gets on the owner's own approved spec tasks in the named repositories (docs/epic-context.md). Machine file only: a repository's .avoozl.json may not set it.

items.description: owner/name, owner/*, or a registered repository ID.
A folder, absolute or under ~/, a worker may read and never write.

mcp.description: Up to 10 MCP servers by alias. A worker reaches one only through Avoozl's relay.

env.description: Names of the environment variables the server may read. Never values.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Ignored and dropped on the next save. lanes.local in the machine Avoozl configuration sets how many chats this machine runs.
